continuityAssumption: 1890s mapped drainage provisionally continued to 1900; other scene years require separate review.
source: NLS OS London five-foot 1893-96 mosaics; source pixels measured from top left

features.evidence: Blue-filled channel east of the sheet join at pixel x350; continuous double-line western reach to Manor Road. Colour change coincides with sheet edge, not a mapped barrier.
Double-line feature linking labelled sluices. Drain versus adjoining path and covered sections require review.

connections.evidence: Aligned drainage features and sluice label on either side of railway/road corridor; underground route and levels unverified.

sectionAssumptions.status: Illustrative section, not surveyed: dimensions, bed and water level are assumptions. Water is independent of the Channelsea tide.
sectionAssumptions.boundaryMeaning: Only the reach within supported reconstructed ground is rendered. Faded ends are model boundaries, not historical dams, outlets or channel ends.
